mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO human_prompt_history_option ( prompt_history_id, option_id, init_regi_pic, init_regi_dttm, final_rvis_pic, final_rvis_dttm ) VALUES
( #{item.promptHistoryId}, #{item.optionId}, #{item.initRegiPic}, #{item.initRegiDttm}, #{item.finalRvisPic}, #{item.finalRvisDttm} )
mapper.select: SELECT hpo.name FROM human_prompt_history_option hpho JOIN human_prompt_option hpo ON hpho.option_id = hpo.id JOIN human_prompt_attr hpa ON hpo.attr_id = hpa.id JOIN human_prompt_step hps ON hpa.step_id = hps.id WHERE hpho.prompt_history_id = #{promptHistoryId} ORDER BY hps.step_number ASC, hpa.sort_order ASC, hpo.sort_order ASC
